# get_isos_fit_for_multiple_raspa_folders { #mofography.raspa_helper.get_isos_fit_for_multiple_raspa_folders }

```python
raspa_helper.get_isos_fit_for_multiple_raspa_folders(
    list_of_folder_paths,
    T,
    order,
)
```

It takes a list of folder paths, and a temperature, and returns a dictionary of the
isosteric heat fits for each folder

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name                 | Type   | Description                                                                             | Default    |
|----------------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| list_of_folder_paths |        | a list of strings, each string being the path to a folder containing RASPA output files | _required_ |
| T                    |        | temperature in K                                                                        | _required_ |
| order                |        | the order of the polynomial fit                                                         | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                              |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | A dictionary of the form {folder_path: isos_fit_for_raspa_folder(folder_path, T, order)} |
